title: Book
description: A schema representing a book and its metadata for the library for, e.g., search results

coverThumbnailWebP.description: Base64 encoded WebP image of the book cover thumbnail

name.description: The full name of the author with titles

portraitThumbnailWebP.description: Base64 encoded WebP image of the author's portrait thumbnail

authors.description: List of authors of the book

numberOfTextPosition.description: The number of text position in the book

category.description: The main category of the book

tags.description: List of tags associated with the book (top 20)

rating.description: The average rating of the book (0 to 5 stars, with one decimal place)

hasValidLicense.description: Indicates whether the library has a valid license for the book at the moment

publishingDate.description: The date when the book was published
